title: Can I SURVIVE 4 Player Chess?
summary: Chess.com 4 Player Chess (free-for-all) on the 14x14 cross board vs three humans (green rated 2500). Players take clockwise turns; captures earn points and a checkmate is worth 20. Tony only counts a first-place finish. He mates yellow early (+21), battles red, and finishes first, beating the 2500-rated green (~7:41).
rules: 4 players (red, blue, yellow, green) on the 14x14 cross-shaped board (8x8 centre plus 3-wide arms; 3x3 corners cut).
Turns go clockwise; each player has a full 16-piece army on their arm.
Points: capturing pieces earns points (pawn 1, minor ~3-5? — 'free five points', 'one-point queen' for promoted queens); checkmating a player = 20 points.
Pawns promote on the 8th rank from their side (centre line) — promoted queens are worth only 1 point.
A checkmated player is eliminated; game continues until one remains or time runs out; most points wins (first place = win).
Short clocks (~1 min each with increments).
win_condition: Finish 1st on points (goal: win one game; achieved).

opponent.name: Three online humans (incl. a 2500)

setup: Standard chess.com 4-player FFA setup: each army on ranks 1-2 of its arm (red bottom, blue left, yellow top, green right).
